nodes.label: NXDOMAIN negative cache in the local resolver blocks a freshly created subdomain long after public resolvers answer correctly
nodes.norm_label: nxdomain negative cache in the local resolver blocks a freshly created subdomain long after public resolvers answer correctly
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-dawnbook/2026-09-27 - transisi-modul-tidak-mulus-di-desktop [ses_f1b87e7ccffevE31vBGr10xOcY].md:L10053] The failing avatars were diagnosed as DNS rather than code: the live HTML and both R2 objects were 200, but the new media subdomain did not resolve on this machine while 1.1.1.1 and Google DoH already returned its A record, and clearing the local resolver cache made it resolve

nodes.label: Every sync event is correlated by the backend-owned job id
nodes.norm_label: backend job id owns every sync event
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-27 - t7-todoist-sync-ui-safety [ses_f1fc5aa3effexLMX4dvoMO7LFb].md:L6698] A stale complete from an older job must never clear a newer run, so an untagged legacy event is honored only when no job is tracked and a job event with a mismatched id is dropped; the diagnosis records that relying on the disabled-button state alone let a stale terminal from job A clear job B

nodes.label: A ref, not state, is the synchronous guard against a double-clicked invoke
nodes.norm_label: a ref, not state, is the synchronous guard against a double-clicked invoke
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-27 - t7-todoist-sync-ui-safety [ses_f1fc5aa3effexLMX4dvoMO7LFb].md:L6696] State updates are async so they cannot block a double-click, and the backend only fails fast while a job already runs, so syncBusyRef gives a synchronous single-flight guard that resets only on invoke failure or a terminal event

nodes.label: Remount recovers in-flight and terminal sync state from the backend activeJob snapshot
nodes.norm_label: remount recovers in-flight and terminal sync state from the backend activejob snapshot
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-27 - t7-todoist-sync-ui-safety [ses_f1fc5aa3effexLMX4dvoMO7LFb].md:L6699] loadSyncStatus restores a running job as loading plus computed percentage and settles a terminal job to idle, so a remount neither loses an in-flight run nor leaves a stuck spinner, and it never clobbers a newer locally tracked job id

nodes.label: Duplicate repair is a read-only preview that never merges by title
nodes.norm_label: read-only duplicate repair preview that never merges by title
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-27 - t7-todoist-sync-ui-safety [ses_f1fc5aa3effexLMX4dvoMO7LFb].md:L6700] The preview is a pure aggregate over tasks plus mappedTaskIds, so a row counts as owned only where retained remote identity proves it, unlinked rows are reported untouched, same-title groups are listed with linked and unlinked counts, and no delete, merge or approve action exists anywhere in the component
